components.name: Quiz answer
components.description: Native radio answer; selection uses fill, border, and an SVG check.
components.css: .ds-answer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:54px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d9c9c2);border-radius:3px;background:var(--paper,#f7f3eb);color:var(--ink,#392b2c);font:400 13px/1.45 var(--sans,"DM Sans",sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}.ds-answer input{appearance:none;flex:0 0 17px;height:17px;margin:0;border:1px solid #94787f;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}.ds-answer:has(input:checked){background:#edd8d7;border-color:var(--wine,#4c2333)}.ds-answer input:checked{background:var(--wine,#4c2333);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #edd8d7}.ds-answer input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b67a27;outline-offset:5px;}.ds-answer svg{width:18px;height:18px;margin-left:auto;fill:none;stroke:var(--wine,#4c2333);stroke-width:1.5;opacity:0}.ds-answer input:checked~svg{opacity:1}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-answer{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-stamps{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;background:var(--wine,#4c2333);padding:16px}.ds-stamps span{padding:8px 12px;border:1px dashed #bc939d;color:#e3c3cc;border-radius:3px;font:400 10px/1.65 var(--sans,"DM Sans",sans-serif);transition:background .35s,transform .45s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-stamps span.ds-collected{background:var(--gold,#e7c789);border-color:var(--gold,#e7c789);color:var(--wine,#4c2333);transform:rotate(-4deg)}.ds-stamps span.ds-collected:nth-child(2){transform:rotate(3deg)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-stamps{gap:7px}.ds-stamps span{font-size:8px;padding:7px 8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-stamps span{transition:none}}

components.description: Native disclosure with a rotating geometric plus; keeps content readable without JavaScript.
components.html:
A 15-mark answer is welcome here.

components.css: .ds-note{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d9c9c2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d9c9c2);background:var(--paper,#f7f3eb)}.ds-note summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:80px;padding:20px 0;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font:500 28px/1.65 var(--serif,Cormorant,Georgia,serif);color:var(--wine,#4c2333)}.ds-note summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-note summary>span:last-child{transition:transform .4s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-note[open] summary>span:last-child{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-note summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b67a27;outline-offset:5px;}.ds-note p{margin:0;padding-bottom:27px;max-width:68ch;color:var(--muted,#705b5c);font:400 14px/1.65 var(--sans,"DM Sans",sans-serif)}@media(hover:hover){.ds-note summary:hover{color:#995365}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-note summary{font-size:25px;line-height:1.1;gap:22px}.ds-note p{font-size:13px;padding-bottom:24px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-note summary>span:last-child{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: An ivory and rose photographic scrapbook for /miss-dee/ and its compatibility pages. Maroon frames the collection, forest green separates listening and trivia, and real portraits lead the opening. The blog retains its own identity. The user authorized this direction after rejecting the sparse premiere; AMC remains a shared joke within the album.
keyCharacteristics: Real portrait collage followed by three featured films and five voice notes.
A 38-item camera roll contains 32 photos and six more films, with filters and a full-size photo dialog.
Optional photo pairs, trivia, scene choices, and stamps; the letter remains available.

rules.name: Media playback
rules.body: Native players use preload="none" and never autoplay. Starting a recording pauses all other players. Preserve original sound and video captions.

rules.name: Source provenance
rules.body: Each shipping raster keeps an adjacent JSON record describing its source or generation. Preserve the distinction between real media, the generated lily illustration, and the existing Ravi Kishan thumbnail. Raw originals and private exports stay outside the repository.

dos: Do preserve the substantial media collection and mobile reading order.
Do keep the letter and native media usable without game completion.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior, keyboard access, and no-JavaScript fallbacks.
donts: Don't apply this identity to the Hugo blog.
Don't autoplay recordings or allow competing players.
Don't turn flexible scene ideas into bookings or promised outcomes.
